secretariat.honesty.title: What this page does not pretend
secretariat.honesty.p1: Signatures are pure in-process Ed25519 (no HSM or TEE); private keys stay in the local keyring.json and the API returns only the public key and its fingerprint.
secretariat.honesty.p2: The timestamp is local-tsa (the local clock), not an RFC 3161 trusted timestamp; verification reports tsa_state=local_only.
secretariat.honesty.p3: An approval signature only proves that this approval was recorded and signed locally; it does not prove real-world consent.
secretariat.honesty.p4: The ledger is append-only: revocation appends a state instead of deleting history, and a broken chain is reported, never rebuilt.
secretariat.honesty.p5: When the server is unreachable this page shows nothing; it never fills the gap with sample data.
secretariat.gate.settings_write: This role lacks settings.write, so write buttons are disabled here (the server would answer 403 as well).
